**Calculation:**

⇒ According to the question,

⇒ Maximum marks in each subject = 100

⇒ Sum total of maximum marks in all the subjects = 100 + 100 +100 + 100 + 100 +100 = 600

⇒ Overall percentage in cs = (95+90+80+85+80+90)/(600) = (520)/(600) × 100 = 86.67%

⇒ Overall percentage in physics = (65+70+80+90+95+90)/(600) = (490)/(600) × 100 = 81.67%

⇒ Overall percentage in chemistry = (90+75+65+85+95+90)/(600) = (500)/(600) × 100 = 83.33%

⇒ Overall percentage in maths = (70+75+70+75+85+95)/(600) = (470)/(600) × 100 = 78.33%

⇒ Overall percentage in history = (70+85+90+90+90+90)/(600) = (515)/(600) × 100 = 85.83%

⇒ Overall percentage in geography = (80+85+95+95+95+90)/(600) = (540)/(600) × 100 = 90%

**Therefore, the overall percentage is highest in geography.**
